svg.title: Failed-change recovery route and return-to-service decision
svg.desc: A failed release or migration is contained in Restricted Recovery Mode while evidence is preserved. The responsible change or recovery authority selects exactly one evidence-proven and approved route: compatible forward repair or complete coordinated recovery in an isolated replacement. If neither route qualifies, service remains restricted. Both routes require exact data checks, independently evidenced security-change reconciliation where applicable, and a separate named authority decision before service returns.
